integrity: The proof uses an explicit convergent family of finite-order orthogonal matrices and the standard continuity requirement for Type-2 computability. No numerical experiment, sampling argument, external certification, or independence claim is used.
scientific_limitations: The obstruction concerns the full isotypic-output convention, including the discrete block-dimension code. It does not prove noncomputability of an unconstrained one-block diagonalizer, does not identify an exact Weihrauch degree, and does not prove that a full Cayley table is minimal advice.
title: Finite cyclic rotations obstruct isotypic block recovery without the group data
